name: One&Only Mandarina
positioning: Rainforest resort of free-standing villas and treehouses on the Riviera Nayarit coast, with a swimmable beach, cliffs, lagoons and estuaries
best_for: Couples wanting a villa or treehouse with its own plunge pool
Families who want a kids club set among tree houses
Travelers drawn to Mexican design, Indigenous-inspired spa rituals and nature trails

facts.text: The resort is set in Mexico's coastal rainforest.
On the Riviera Nayarit coast, the resort has emerald cliffs, palm-fringed sands, lagoons and estuaries, and a swimmable beach.
The Mexican-inspired design showcases artisanal makers and local creators.
Rooms have beds draped in Mexican textiles and ceramic mugs made by artisans in Oaxaca.
The grounds have hiking trails past the property's lagoons and estuaries.
The resort is within easy driving distance of the beach towns of Sayulita and San Pancho.
The resort is pet-friendly, offering pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies for dogs.
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the resort.
Carao by Enrique Olvera is a coastal-inspired restaurant.
Alma is an open-air, garden-to-plate restaurant.

highlights.text: Each free-standing villa and treehouse has its own private plunge pool, with views of the jungle canopy or the Pacific Ocean.
The spa's treatment rooms are built within a natural volcanic rock garden.
Spa treatments are inspired by Indigenous and pre-Hispanic cultures, including mud bath treatments and sessions in an on-site temazcal sweat lodge.
Rock carvings by the local Cora and Huichol cultures are present on the property and have been preserved.
Every booking comes with a designated butler for all requests.

considerations.text: The resort does not accept cash payments; bills are settled by credit card.
High season in Riviera Nayarit runs from October to April, while July and August are hotter and more humid.
The resort is about an hour by road from Puerto Vallarta International Airport.
